title: No test for KARI encrypt round-trip; encrypt produces KARI but decrypt skips it
description: encrypt() fully implements KARI for P-256 and P-384 recipients. decrypt() silently skips all KARI RecipientInfo entries. There is no test exercising encrypt(EC cert), and no test demonstrating the round-trip failure. A caller who follows the documented pattern — encrypt to an EC cert, then decrypt — will get NoMatchingRecipient with no explanation. The gap between encrypt (works) and decrypt (skips) is undocumented in the public API of either function.
close_reason: deferred: KARI decrypt not yet implemented; test is blocked on that feature
